bank_name: Real-Time English Tutor Original Oral Placement Bank
content_policy: Original project-authored prompts only; no proprietary test content and no runtime prompt generation.

items.main_prompt: Tell me what you usually do after you wake up and before you leave home.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Describe two or three things you do in the morning, in the order you do them.
items.follow_up_prompt: Which part of your morning do you like most, and why?
items.follow_up_clarification_prompt: Name one morning activity you like and give one simple reason.

review.author: project-team
review.notes: Requires named human owner sign-off before formal validation claims.

items.main_prompt: Tell me about a place near your home that you often visit.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Name a place near your home and say what you do there.
items.follow_up_prompt: Who do you usually go there with?
items.follow_up_clarification_prompt: Say whether you go alone or with another person.

items.main_prompt: Tell me about a food or drink you like and say why you like it.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Name one food or drink you like and give one reason.
items.follow_up_prompt: When do you usually have it?
items.follow_up_clarification_prompt: Say what time or on what occasion you usually have it.

items.main_prompt: Describe a person you know well. Tell me what the person is like and one thing you do together.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Choose someone you know. Describe the person and one activity you do together.

items.main_prompt: You are in a stationery shop. Ask me for two notebooks and a pen, then ask for the total price.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Pretend I work in the shop. Ask for two notebooks, one pen, and the total price.
items.follow_up_prompt: The blue notebooks are unavailable. Choose another color and confirm how many you want.
items.follow_up_clarification_prompt: Choose a different notebook color and repeat the number you need.

review.author: project-team
review.notes: Predictable transaction with one changed condition.

items.main_prompt: You need a bus that arrives before ten in the morning. Ask me about the departure time and ticket price.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Pretend I work at the bus station. Ask when the bus leaves and how much the ticket costs.
items.follow_up_prompt: That bus is full. Ask about another bus and decide whether the new time is suitable.
items.follow_up_clarification_prompt: Ask for a different bus, then say if its time works for you.

items.main_prompt: You want to book a haircut on Monday at four o'clock. Call the salon and ask me for that appointment.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Pretend I work at a hair salon. Ask for a haircut appointment on Monday at four o'clock.
items.follow_up_prompt: Four o'clock is unavailable, but six o'clock is free. Respond and confirm the day and new time.
items.follow_up_clarification_prompt: Say if six o'clock works, then repeat Monday and the time you choose.

review.author: project-team
review.notes: Revised to remove ambiguous service and scheduling frame.

items.main_prompt: You bought a lamp yesterday, but it does not work. Explain the problem to the shop assistant and ask for a replacement or refund.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Pretend I work in the shop. Say when you bought the broken lamp and ask for a solution.

items.main_prompt: Tell me about a time when a team project did not go as planned. Explain what happened and how the team responded.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Describe a team problem, why it happened, and what the team did next.
items.follow_up_prompt: What would you do differently if the same problem happened again?
items.follow_up_clarification_prompt: Choose one different action and explain why it would help.

items.main_prompt: Tell me about a skill you learned. Explain why you chose it, what was difficult, and how you improved.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Choose one skill. Explain your reason, one difficulty, and how you got better.
items.follow_up_prompt: What advice would you give to someone beginning that skill?
items.follow_up_clarification_prompt: Give one or two useful pieces of advice to a beginner.

items.main_prompt: Imagine you are organizing a small event and the main speaker cancels that morning. Explain two possible solutions and choose one.
items.main_clarification_prompt: The speaker cancelled. Give two ways to continue the event and say which way is better.
items.follow_up_prompt: How would you explain the change to the people attending?
items.follow_up_clarification_prompt: Say what you would tell the audience about the change.

review.author: project-team
review.notes: Hypothetical task avoids requiring prior event experience.

items.main_prompt: A student has too much work for one week. Compare two ways to organize the tasks, choose one, and explain why it is better.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Give two possible study plans, choose one plan, and explain your reason.

items.main_prompt: Some programs require every student to complete an unpaid internship. Discuss the benefits and problems, then state your position.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Compare the advantages and disadvantages of compulsory unpaid internships and give your view.
items.follow_up_prompt: Supporters say experience is more valuable than short-term pay. How would you respond?
items.follow_up_clarification_prompt: Answer the argument that experience should matter more than payment.

items.main_prompt: A city can either lower bus fares or invest in more frequent service. Compare the options and recommend one.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Compare cheaper tickets with more frequent buses, then choose which policy the city should use.
items.follow_up_prompt: How might your recommendation affect people who live far from the city center?
items.follow_up_clarification_prompt: Explain how people in distant areas could be helped or harmed by your choice.

items.main_prompt: A school wants to replace most teacher feedback with automated feedback. Evaluate the idea and propose safeguards.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Discuss benefits and risks of automated learning feedback and suggest ways to make it safer.
items.follow_up_prompt: The school says it cannot afford both systems. How would you adjust your proposal?
items.follow_up_clarification_prompt: Revise your plan for a limited budget while protecting feedback quality.

items.main_prompt: Design a fair attendance policy that allows flexibility for genuine difficulties without making participation meaningless. Explain and defend your balance.
items.main_clarification_prompt: Propose an attendance rule that is both fair and flexible, then explain how it prevents misuse.
